exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to carry out, to take out, to bring out, to remove
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: носи́ть — to carry, to bear (a burden); произнести́ — to pronounce, to articulate; приноси́ть — to bring (by foot), to fetch; вы́нести — to carry out, to take out, to bring out, to remove.
